headline: Pricing gains fuel growth as full-year guidance rises
summary_short: Republic Services grew Q2 2026 revenue 4.6% y/y to $4.43B and diluted EPS 5.1% y/y to $1.84, then raised full-year revenue, EBITDA, EPS, and free-cash-flow guidance and lifted its quarterly dividend about 7%.
summary_long: Revenue rose 4.6% y/y to $4.43B on 3.7% organic growth in recycling & waste, a 0.2% decline in environmental solutions, and 1.1% from acquisitions; core pricing of 5.3% outpaced a 1.6% volume decline. Diluted EPS rose 5.1% y/y to $1.84 (adjusted EPS $1.85, +4.5%); net margin held near 12.8% even as pretax income fell 2.9% y/y on a wider unconsolidated equity-method investment loss. Adjusted EBITDA margin was flat y/y at 32.1%, overcoming a 50bp headwind from prior-year event-driven landfill volumes. The company repurchased $337M of stock, raised its quarterly dividend about 7% to $0.670/share, and raised FY2026 guidance for revenue, adjusted EBITDA, adjusted diluted EPS, and adjusted free cash flow.

drivers.explanation: Growth reflects 3.7% organic growth in recycling & waste, a 0.2% decline in environmental solutions, and 1.1% from acquisitions; core price of 5.3% outpaced a 1.6% volume decline.
Adjusted EBITDA margin (non-GAAP) held at 32.1% y/y, overcoming a 50bp headwind from event-driven landfill volumes received in the prior-year quarter.
Pretax income fell 2.9% y/y as loss from unconsolidated equity-method investments widened to $58M from $2M; the release discloses the figure but does not explain the swing.
Diluted EPS growth of 5.1% y/y outpaced net income growth of 2.9%; the gap is arithmetic, from a 1.8% y/y reduction in weighted diluted shares via the quarter's $337M buyback.
CEO cited pricing in excess of cost inflation and disciplined cost management as driving accelerated revenue and EBITDA growth, prompting the full-year guidance raise.
